![Cross-section of the IHP SG13 technology (not to scale): five thin metal layers (Metal1 to Metal5) for dense routing and two thick top metal layers (TopMetal1, TopMetal2) for power routing, inductors, and low-loss RF interconnects, with the MIM capacitor embedded between Metal5 and TopMetal1. The FEOL devices are shown at the bottom, and the numbers give the layer and dielectric thicknesses. Source: Fig. 1.1.1 of the *SG13G2 Process Specification Rev. 1.2*, Copyright 2023 IHP PDK Authors, licensed under Apache-2.0, taken from [IHP-Open-PDK](https://github.com/IHP-GmbH/IHP-Open-PDK) and cropped out of the original page.](/content/technology/figures/ihp-sg13g2-cross-section.png){#fig-metal-stack}
